s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent lesion of the nasal vestibule with local invasion
salient_findings: Recurrent lesion of the right nasal vestibule mucosa
Tumor within the nasal vestibule floor and ala
key_facts: Female patient in her 50s
Never-smoker
Initial lesion biopsied 5 years prior
Initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma
p63 positive, pancytokeratin positive, and p16 negative on initial biopsy
Lesion recurred 8 months prior to presentation
Second excision showed p63 positive and p16 negative with positive margins
Imaging showed thicker right ala compared to the left ala
Tumor extended into the floor of the nasal vestibule
Microscopic examination showed downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent lesion with local invasion and atypical keratinocytes

shortlist.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma with recurrence

shortlist.label: Adnexal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Lesion originated in the nasal vestibule with features of adnexal tumors

shortlist.label: Basal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Possible given the location and local invasion of the tumor

shortlist.label: Verrucous carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Downward papillomatous proliferation of keratinocytes is consistent with this diagnosis

raw.rationale: The microscopic examination showing downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes is consistent with verrucous carcinoma, and the clinical presentation of a slowly growing, locally aggressive tumor also supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While p63 positivity is seen in squamous cell carcinoma, the lack of significant atypia and the specific growth pattern are not typical for this diagnosis

rejected.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The initial biopsy was reported as a hidradenoma, but the clinical behavior and microscopic features are not typical for a malignant hidradenocarcinoma

rejected.label: Adnexal carcinoma
rejected.why: The clinical and microscopic features do not specifically suggest an adnexal origin for the tumor

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The microscopic features and immunohistochemical profile do not support a diagnosis of basal cell carcinoma
